agents.reasoning_cot: Cindy is the only durable threat and overpays near 80–94; Bob is budget-broken, David/Eric are effectively noncompetitive. I conserve on comfortable days and only spike when low HP/no-water or when yesterday shows Cindy pressing. With supply always 15–25 and my need 13, one unit likely exists, so selective outbidding beats constant wars.

Cindy outbid heavily yesterday (avg ~80, max ~93.5) and survived 10 days, suggesting she can afford aggressive bids. Alex bid moderate and survived; David/Eric died early with near-zero bids. To avoid overpaying, bid around a mid-to-high band unless my HP is critical.

My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low. It reacts to opponents' highest previous bid by slightly outbidding them, especially if water is scarce. In the late game, I become more aggressive if my budget allows, aiming for a win.

Cindy is aggressive with high budget reserves, while Alex is moderate. I will track the highest bid from yesterday to stay competitive. If supply is scarce, I will increase my bid to ensure survival, prioritizing budget preservation when supply is high.
